supports: LM Studio has a native v1 REST API under /api/v1
the native chat endpoint can receive a per-request context length
model records expose unique keys, loaded instances, configured context length, maximum context length, format, and optional capabilities
does_not_prove: a selected model is loaded now
a declared capability succeeds for a particular request

supports: POST /api/v1/chat accepts model, input, system_prompt, stream, timeout-relevant request processing, context_length, and store controls
store=false can avoid server-side chat storage
responses identify the model instance and return typed output items and token/performance statistics
unsupported reasoning settings error rather than silently succeeding
does_not_prove: every model supports every optional setting
completion merely because a request was accepted

supports: POST /api/v1/models/load can load a selected model and returns a loaded model instance identity
load configuration can include context length
does_not_prove: Phase 1 runtime should own model loading

supports: LM Studio can enforce JSON-schema structured output through /v1/chat/completions
not all models are capable of structured output
does_not_prove: structured output for the configured model
structured output on the selected native Phase 1 chat profile

supports: tool use is a model request for code to execute rather than model-side execution
native and fallback tool-use support differ and results vary by model
LM Studio exposes POST /v1/chat/completions and supports non-streaming and streaming request parameters
does_not_prove: that the compatibility endpoint is required for the native Phase 1 binding

phase1_protocol_decision.rationale: The native v1 profile exposes loaded-instance and context evidence plus a typed non-streaming response. The provider binding remains beneath IF-MODEL-EXECUTION and may be replaced without changing Blu canon.
